leads.name: Downy Oaks of Bosco dell'Incoronata (five register trees)
leads.reason: Public regional park (Parco naturale regionale Bosco Incoronata, est. 2006); register girths 308/-/-/250/325 cm, heights 12 to 20 m; 02 to 05 stand within about 40 m of each other. Alive context: WWF Foggia 'Il Bosco Monumentale' event 28 Sept 2025 proposed plaques for three monumental oaks (cultura.gov.it event listing seen only as a search snippet; page refused connection). A komoot comment says visits may need an appointment. Wiki Loves Earth 2024 Commons photos by Ferdi2005 (CC BY-SA 4.0) show park signs 'albero madre 4' (41.3908,15.6374) and 'albero madre 7' (41.3909,15.6395) 500 m or more from the register points, so not tied to register ids. Not findable: no photo of a register tree, no confirmed pin. A visit to the park office (direttoreparco@comune.foggia.it, 0881 814098) would settle access and which are the mother trees.
